notes.title: “SHANHAI: Myth Origins” Demo is now officially released
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="5E1wnq5d_Us;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hello, Adventurers!
We’re excited to announce that the [b]SHANHAI: Myth Origins[/b] [b]Demo[/b] is officially live! Heartfelt thanks to everyone who joined the [b]Playtest[/b]—your suggestions and feedback have greatly helped us improve the game. With the Demo going live, the [b]Playtest will be closed in the near future[/b] (after closure, it will no longer be available for download or updates). Please switch to the [b]Demo[/b] to continue playing, share your feedback, and [b]add the game to your Wishlist[/b] to support us! [b]With your companionship, the scroll of the Shanhaijing has officially unfurled.[/b]
[b]Download and play the Demo[/b]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639350/_/"][/dynamiclink][b]Add the game to your Wishlist (very important!)[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540450/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]2 full stages + 2 Divine-Beast Bosses:[/b] a more complete flow with tuned pacing
• [b]New character — the archer “Hanshuang”:[/b] high mobility, high attack speed, and burst damage
• [b]All-new Fa-Bao system:[/b] collect and unleash the power of legendary artifacts (e.g., [b]Dinghai Shenzhen[/b], [b]Dingfeng Zhu[/b], [b]Juling Fu[/b])
• [b]Exotic-beast capture (Juling Fu):[/b] seal beasts into bronze statues and summon them to aid you in battle
• [b]New map “Misty Forest”:[/b] encounter more creatures inspired by the [b]Shanhaijing[/b]
We will continue iterating on Demo content and values based on everyone’s gameplay data and feedback. Please stay tuned for upcoming patch notes.[/p][p]About the Playtest closure
• [b]Why close it?[/b]
The Playtest aimed to validate core gameplay and stability with a smaller audience; with the Demo now officially released, we’re unifying the entry point to the [b]Demo[/b] to centralize feedback and version maintenance.
• [b]What should existing Playtest players do?[/b]
Simply download and launch the [b]Demo[/b] from the Store page to keep playing. The Playtest will no longer be maintained or updated.
• [b]Will data carry over?[/b]
Progress and data from the test period are [b]not guaranteed[/b] to carry over to the Demo/full release (subject to in-game announcements). Please treat the [b]Demo[/b] as the main branch for future play and feedback.[/p][p]FAQ
• [b]Q1: What’s the difference between the Demo and the Playtest?[/b]
A: The Demo is a public build with more stable content and a more complete experience; subsequent fixes and tuning will prioritize the Demo.
• [b]Q2: How often will the Demo be updated?[/b]
A: We’ll roll out updates based on issue severity and feedback priority. Major updates will be announced via Steam News and on Discord.
• [b]Q3: Will the system requirements change?[/b]
A: Optimization is ongoing. Please keep your GPU drivers and OS up to date; if you encounter performance/crash issues, report them in our Discord [b]#bug-report[/b] channel (include hardware, OS version, GPU driver, reproduction steps, and logs).
• [b]Q4: Does the Demo support co-op?[/b]
A: Yes. The Demo supports up to [b]4-player[/b] co-op to challenge Divine-Beast Bosses—bring your friends![/p][p]Developers’ Note
Thank you to every player who offered valuable feedback during the Playtest—you made [b]SHANHAI: Myth Origins[/b] better. The Demo is just the beginning of a new journey. We’ll continue polishing [b]combat feel, balance, Fa-Bao builds, multi-language localization, and network stability[/b]. Please keep the feedback coming and share your epic moments![/p][p]Thank you again for your support—see you in the [b]Demo[/b]![/p]

notes.title: Armor, pets, and treasures are all here!
notes.content: [p][b]The beta version of "Shanhai: Origins of Mythology" has received a major update before the demo version, with all armor systems, pets, and magic weapon systems fully implemented.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555432/d4d656e03a3733578261d1c50d3fd1ad12bd9b0e.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]First installation of armor system: [/h3][list][*][p]The armor can be synthesized and upgraded to the highest purple level, equipped with a combination system of items. Multiple items of the same item can be combined to create powerful item abilities, as well as active and passive skills. [/p][/*][*][p]Silver Scale Chest Armor Set: A suit of armor suitable for warriors, which can stimulate the powerful abilities of active skill "Heavenly Gang Battle Qi" and passive skill "Heaven Earth Reaction" through combination of entries. [/p][/*][*][p]Underworld Set: A set of armor suitable for mages. By combining entries, it can activate the active skill "Spirit Shield" to increase the survival ability of mages, as well as the passive skill "Extreme Flash" to greatly enhance their explosive power.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555432/2487565b2d3976790cd8eb80774b460c8bfbcd91.png"][/img][/p][h3]First implementation of the magic weapon system: [/h3][list][*][p]Send General Bronze Statue (Magic Weapon): At present, it appears directly in the player's backpack column. Players can obtain the skill "Send General Skill (Cunli)" by placing the magic weapon in the treasure bag[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555432/32a461c86a23adc212f334159c6df16fba7a1e96.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]First implementation of pet system: [/h3][list][*][p]By using the skill of sending generals (tanuki), players can summon a strange beast (tanuki) to fight for them and activate the Five Elements to form bonds with them.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555432/8cd0efd64217f9636974b53e7a0481f21073e833.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Dynamic changes in the blood volume of exotic beasts
notes.content: [p]This update mainly involves dynamic adjustments to the health of exotic beasts, ensuring that their HP changes as the number of players varies. Additionally, it fixes an issue where spirit beads could be synthesized onto weapons.[/p][p][/p][h2]Playtest v1.1.5 version update[/h2][p]Content adjustment:[/p][list][*][p]Adjustments have been made to the settings panel, making entries clearer.[/p][/*][*][p]The health of all exotic beasts has been adjusted and will vary with the number of players.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Issue fix:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that occurred during item synthesis.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: SHANHAI:Myth Origins — Playtest Is Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Adventurers!
The [b]Playtest build[/b] of [b]Myth Origins[/b] is now open to everyone. This is our very first public test, and your feedback means a lot to us. You may encounter unexpected issues during the Playtest—please let us know as soon as you can and we’ll work quickly to address them. Most of all, we hope the game brings you joy—especially when teaming up with friends.[/p][p][b]Share Your Feedback[/b]
Post your suggestions, bug reports, and impressions in our Steam Discussions. We’ll review them promptly and keep improving the experience:
[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3540540/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3540540/discussions/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting [i]Myth Origins[/i]. Have fun, and see you in the world of ancient myths![/p]
